scenarios.title: Current activity
scenarios.expected: Clicking 'Get Current Activity' reads ActivitySensor.GetDefaultAsync() and fills Activity/Confidence/Timestamp; with no sensor present it shows 'No activity sensor available on this device.'

scenarios.title: Activity history
scenarios.expected: Clicking 'Get Activity History' queries history and fills Count/First*/Last*; with no sensor shows the no-sensor message / 'No data'.

scenarios.title: Events
scenarios.expected: 'ReadingChanged On' subscribes to ReadingChanged; 'ReadingChanged Off' unsubscribes. By design 'Off' is DISABLED until 'On' is pressed (OnNavigatedTo disables it). With no sensor, 'On' reports the no-sensor message.

scenarios.title: Background activity
scenarios.expected: 'Register Task' builds an ActivitySensorTrigger background task and registers it (status -> 'Registered', toggles button enablement); 'Unregister Task' removes it. By design 'Unregister' is DISABLED until registered. Background-access + sensor policy gate the outcome.
